title: Top-level HierarchicalMenu facet counts incorrect when combined with RefinementList
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

When you have both:
- A RefinementList with a value selected ("Brand: Samsung")
- A HierarchicalMenu with at least a second level selected ("Category: Audio > Headphones")

The facet counts on the root level items in the HierarchicalMenu are wrong.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

This is easy to reproduce in the samples:
https://react-instantsearch.netlify.app/examples/e-commerce/search/

1. Select **Brand: Samsung** and **Category: Audio**. All is ok so far: 

![2022-08-16 19_07_59-E-commerce demo _ Algolia](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46369335/184842870-abde17bf-e250-4415-bc86-1c5740054b20.png)

2. Now select the second level category **"Audio > Headphones"**

The facet counts on the top-level categories are all incorrect - they have reverted to their original, unfiltered value (before the brand was selected). Some previously hidden categories have even re-appeared, and selecting them immediately returns no results and gives a very jarring UX.

Confusingly, the counts on the Audio category itself and its children are all correct.


![2022-08-16 19_08_08-E-commerce demo _ Algolia](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46369335/184843868-e366d5f3-1066-4e04-834e-a9f5c5e10891.png)

comments.body: Hi @themerk , thanks for your feedback! This has been corrected in the latest version ([v6.33.0](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/releases/tag/v6.33.0)).
